channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: The Pentagon says China has fielded a new long-range missile. Here's why the DF-27 is unusual.
item.description: The DF-27, a conventional strike missile believed to be able to target ships, has an estimated range that reaches parts of the continental US.

item.title: Stop calling everything a flop: It was a good year for the movies.
item.description: Box-office numbers stagnated in 2025, but standout films such as "Sinners," "Sorry, Baby," and "Splitsville" prove that creative cinema still thrives.

item.title: Amazon allows visa workers stranded in India to work remotely — but there's a catch
item.description: Amazon allows India-based employees affected by H-1B visa delays to work remotely until March, with strict restrictions on coding.

item.title: Thiel Capital, founded by billionaire Peter Thiel, opens a new office in Miami as California debates a wealth tax
item.description: Thiel Capital, founded by, billionaire Peter Thiel, said it opened a new office in Miami.

item.title: After a breakup, I traveled for a year to learn how to be alone again. It led me to move to a country I'd never imagined calling home.
item.description: When Claire Drinkwater boarded a plane alone to India, she wondered if she'd finally lost her mind.

item.title: Gen Z-ers are taking to Pinterest to find their aesthetic and figure out interview fits, an exec for the platform says
item.description: A Pinterest executive said Gen Z uses the platform to figure out their aesthetic, which means looking at interview outfits or dorm room ideas.

item.title: A single mom moved to Thailand with her daughter. She says the slower life brought them closer than ever.
item.description: Moving abroad was something Donetta Barber had always wanted, but it scared her.

item.title: Meet the 13-year-old and his teen sister vibe coding and competing in Cursor's 24-hour hackathon
item.description: A 13-year-old and his teen sister picked up vibe coding and ended up competing together in a 24-hour hackathon with their dad.

item.title: Sprinkles Cupcakes is closing, says the cofounder
item.description: Sprinkles was one of the last holdouts of the 2000s cupcake boom. The husband-and-wife cofounders sold the company to private equity in 2012.

item.title: Thieves in Germany drilled into a bank vault, stealing tens of millions in valuables
item.description: Thieves broke into a German bank vault, making off with tens of millions of dollars of valuables from over 3,000 safe deposit boxes.
